subject: demo-banner-double-render
insight: The demo banner renders twice on first paint when the locale switcher mounts late.
evidence: Seen twice in one invented session; reported by kollege@example.org.

subject: price-label-rounding
insight: Price labels round half-down in one locale and half-up in another.
evidence: Invented example: two snapshot diffs in the sample shop.

subject: commit-message-language
insight: Commit subjects in the sample project are written in the imperative mood.
evidence: Invented example: review note on a sample merge request.

subject: lint-before-push
insight: Running the linter before pushing avoids a red pipeline on formatting-only issues.

subject: two-agent-waves
insight: Two-agent waves finished faster than four-agent waves on the sample repo.

subject: sleep-in-tests
insight: Fixed sleeps in sample tests made them flaky under load.
evidence: Invented example: two sample CI reruns.

subject: list-view-scroll-reset
insight: The sample list view resets its scroll position when a list item re-renders.
evidence: Seen twice in one invented session; reported by kollege@example.org.

subject: guide-heading-case
insight: Headings in the sample guide use sentence case.
evidence: Invented example: one sample docs review.
